# Easier Now

> Easier Now is a to-do list app that schedules your tasks into your working day and shows you 1 at a time, the most valuable first. 14 days free, no card.

Easier Now plans the day around your fixed commitments (meetings, routines, anything tied to a time) and fits flexible tasks into the gaps that are left. Each task carries urgency, importance and pay grade, which decide its place in the queue. It connects to Google Calendar. After the 14-day free trial it costs $10.99 a month, or $8.25 a month when paid for the year.

## Features

- [Now](https://easiernow.co/features/now/): the 1 task to do right now
- [Priority](https://easiernow.co/features/priority/): urgency, importance and pay grade
- [Catch up](https://easiernow.co/features/catch-up/): bringing overdue work back 1 at a time
- [Google Calendar](https://easiernow.co/features/google-calendar/): planning tasks around your meetings
- [Notes](https://easiernow.co/features/notes/): notes kept with your tasks
